verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents connecting to any MCP server, including existing external servers through a managed proxy, so developers can plug in third-party, community-built MCP integrations. The evidence shows no community marketplace, registry, or install flow for externally contributed nodes or components; the other extension paths (hosted MCPs, skills) are self-built or org-managed rather than community-sourced. Missing for 10: a community node/component marketplace or registry, a documented install flow for community-contributed integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
